name: Install Dependencies
command: sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y build-essential git python3.12 python3.12-venv python3.12-dev cmake pkg-config libsqlite3-dev libxml2-dev libbz2-dev libssl-dev libc-ares-dev libgsl-dev libgtk-3-dev

name: Clone ns-3
command: rm -rf ns-3-dev && git clone https://gitlab.com/nsnam/ns-3-dev.git && cd ns-3-dev

name: Set Up Python Environment
command: python3.12 -m venv ns3venv && source ns3venv/bin/activate && python -m pip install --upgrade pip && pip install sionna==1.2.0 sionna-rt==1.2.0 pybind11==2.11.1 cppyy==3.5.0 && echo 'source ns3venv/bin/activate' >> ~/.bashrc
verify: which python3.12 && python3.12 -m venv ns3venv && source ns3venv/bin/activate && python -m pip install --upgrade pip && pip install sionna==1.2.0 sionna-rt==1.2.0 pybind11==2.11.1 cppyy==3.5.0

name: Install ns-3
command: cd ns-3-dev && rm -rf build && mkdir build && cd build && cmake .. && sudo cmake --build . --target install -- -j 47
